notes: Questions name the work, as a researcher asking about a known text would. The v1 set paraphrased each work without its title and measured title-free lexical recall; it remains as a documented retrieval gap, not an admission gate.

cases.question: In the Nicolay draft of the Gettysburg Address, what did Lincoln say the nation was testing?
What must police tell a suspect before questioning them in custody, according to Miranda v. Arizona?
How did Roe v. Wade divide pregnancy into stages for regulating abortion?
What did Article 5 of the North Atlantic Treaty pledge members to do if one of them was attacked?
In Adventures of Huckleberry Finn, how does the runaway boy travel down the Mississippi with an escaped slave?
What did Lincoln's Preliminary Emancipation Proclamation of September 1862 announce would happen on the first day of 1863?
expected_document_titles: Preliminary Emancipation Proclamation, September 22, 1862 original draft

cases.question: What updated protections did the First Geneva Convention of 1906 set for sick and wounded soldiers and hospital staff?
What did Barack Obama say about democracy and civic participation in his Farewell Address?
How does the Constitution of the Republic of Iceland divide legislative, executive, and judicial power?
expected_document_titles: Constitution of the Republic of Iceland (1944)

cases.question: What emergency powers and term rules did the 1972 Constitution of the Republic of Korea give the president?
expected_document_titles: Constitution of the Republic of Korea (1972)
